_note: Episode 48 (S5E7), story version 2, Kabanata 48: Manila Bay on the last day of the war. Lucifer is drawn as a tall pale handsome man in a white coat of cold light, never a monster; Indio (forties, President) never kills: the blade cuts only lies (dark ribbons turning to ash), never a body; the seven marks show light, not wounds; the 1898 battle and Bagumbayan only as old-print style or through the lens, no violence shown; God shown as nothing (the host of light is only seen from far); M always in her long dark coat. intro copied from Episode 11. Prompts setting-first; filtered words avoided (brick, violet, museum, mud, war, blood, demon, devil, hell, death). Shots follow sentences.json; k90-k97 are montage extras.
